processSection.title: How is salt made at PRODUSAL?
processSection.description: Sun, wind, and sea: this is how we turn salt water into industrial salt.

steps.name: Seawater
steps.description: Controlled intake of water from the Los Olivitos marsh into the complex's first concentration lagoons.

steps.name: Concentration
steps.description: The sun and the Zulia trade winds evaporate the water across 3,200 hectares, raising its salinity.

steps.name: Crystallization
steps.description: Saturated brine flows into the crystallizers, where sodium chloride precipitates as salt crystals.

steps.name: Washing
steps.description: Harvested salt goes through two industrial washing lines with fresh brines that remove impurities.

steps.name: Stockpiling
steps.description: Storage in the yard for natural drainage and open-air drying.

steps.name: Dispatch
steps.description: Direct delivery at our plant in different packaging formats for the whole country.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: Transparent, confidential, and secure management of commercial data for our clients, suppliers, and partners.

responsible.title: 1. Data controller identification
responsible.address: Los Olivitos Saltworks Industrial Complex, Miranda, Eastern Coast of Lake Maracaibo, Zulia, Venezuela.

sections.title: 2. Personal and commercial data we collect
sections.content: Through our web forms and official channels, PRODUSAL C.A. only requests and stores the data needed for B2B commercial interactions: full name, corporate email, company name, and requirement specifications (estimated tonnage, salt type, delivery destination).

sections.title: 3. Purpose of data processing
sections.content: The provided data is used exclusively to: handle purchase requests, provide official technical data sheets and laboratory certificates of analysis, coordinate industrial dispatch logistics (bulk, big bags, and bags), and respond to commercial inquiries.

sections.title: 4. Confidentiality and non-disclosure to third parties
sections.content: PRODUSAL C.A. does not sell, rent, lease, or transfer customer or prospective client data to third parties under any circumstances. All commercial information is held confidentially in compliance with the Venezuelan legal framework and international good practices.

sections.title: 5. Data security and storage
sections.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures (TLS/HTTPS in-transit encryption, access controls restricted to authorized commercial personnel) to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

sections.title: 6. Data subject rights (access, correction, and deletion)
sections.content: At any time, users or corporate representatives may exercise their rights to access, rectify, update, or delete their data by sending an email to infoprodusal@grupomimesa.com with the subject line 'Data protection'.

sections.title: 7. Use of cookies and web technologies
sections.content: This website uses only essential technical cookies to enable browsing, remember the language preference (Spanish/English), and optimize loading, without invasive tracking or third-party advertising.
